discovery emits RuntimeProgram.Event directly, with no retained Graph, Block, Instruction, Bytes, Rope, or payload list. Literal atoms designate existing charged logical sequence roots. A literal consumer derives its actual length from the arena, emits beginLiteral, and traverses any number of RuntimeSequence image spans before resuming static syntax. No contiguous-image coalescing or payload-size cap is required. The caller retains every ownedSequences root and this bounded cursor through the complete admission acknowledgment, including retained credit, before committing the produced continuation; cancellation releases through the shared arena protocol, never by dropping an unacknowledged handle. Event work is bounded control work, separate from admission allocation and literal ownership.
